notes.title: SGF Trailer & Release Year!
notes.notes:
We are stoked to announce that Grave Seasons is launching in 2026 on PC and consoles! It's been a wonderful journey and we are so excited to share what we have been cooking up. 

This SGF, we had the chance to participate in the PC Gaming Showcase and show off our new gameplay trailer!


[previewyoutube="54sXez32F6I;full"][/previewyoutube]
If you've been following Grave Seasons, we hope you're excited for how much it's grown and shaped up over the year. Hinted on our steam but Grave Seasons takes the traditional mechanics you know and love in farming sims, and brings out the best (and worst) outcomes from them.

This announcement also includes our new logo, designed by Charles Bae -- which features a little taste of the potential horrors we've got brewing. Supernatural killers, murder mysteries, the dangerous occult and a town that can't seem to let go...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45237508/223ef1a72019d0f26771287c8d0adeb81f2cf137.png"]

We also had the chance to share some behind the scenes work in the Women-Led Games Showcase! Check it out!
[previewyoutube="NPJ3t55NeuQ;full"][/previewyoutube]
Thank you for the support! We look forward to sharing more soon!
